Players Committee card image of [[Captain Rex, 501st Legion (ALT)]] (the same image re-uploaded as a full-size GIF; recorded with that printing, not as a separate version), game text: “Your clones deploy -1 here. While at an [Episode I] battleground site, adds one battle destiny. Permanent weapon is •Twin Blasters (may target a character for free; draw two destiny; target hit and forfeit -3 if total destiny -2 > defense value).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/captainrex501stlegion_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 3f533fb] (19 February 2021).
